notes: One line per edition from the keeper of the Chronicle, saying what the day is in the longer story since 1945, by these headlines. Lines are added, never revised or removed.

lines.line: On 29 October 2026 the Iran war's price rise is read into borrowing costs: the Fed holds, Korean mortgage rates hit a 14-year high, and the UK cuts growth over the war.
On 30 October 2026, days before the US midterms, Washington is reported pressing for lower oil prices in two wars, and US growth of 3.4% is credited to AI.
On 31 October 2026, with Brent at $117.64, the Iran war's price rise reaches wage talks, and Taiwan's state funds buy as a US tech sell-off over AI spending deepens.
On 1 November 2026, days before the US midterms, Turkey raises its fuel tax as US pump prices rise and Iran talks stall; France deploys 70,000 for youth rallies.
On 2 November 2026, the eve of the US midterms, Brent falls to $111 as Netanyahu is reported pressing for an Iran strike after the vote and Trump says talks go well.
On 2 November 2026, eve of the US midterms, oil falls 7% on reports Khamenei ordered the Iran war resolved and the Justice Department asks to halt a California count.
On 3 November 2026, US midterm polling day, the Strait of Hormuz stays shut as the US strikes Iran while Qatar reports US-Iran talks through its mediation progressing.
On 4 November 2026, the day after the US midterms, Trump's party has lost Congress, with Trump and Vance naming the Iran war and prices; oil falls more than 8%.
On 5 November 2026 the Bank of England raises to 4% against the Iran war's oil price while Mexico and Brazil cut; the Nasdaq falls more than 5% after the midterms.
On 6 November 2026 Iran says two tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Trump calls the US vote rigged, and the EU charges TikTok over its recommendation system.
On 7 November 2026 the US strikes Iran again, Italy lets its diesel excise cut lapse with the war unresolved, and Tesla says it will stop making the Cybertruck.
On 8 November 2026 the US-Iran war is reported paused as Washington asks Iraq to shut its Iran crossings and the Houthis strike Riyadh and Aramco.
On 10 November 2026 Brent falls 5% as Trump speaks of momentum in Iran talks, while Nvidia shares drop 8-9% after its chief admits an affair with an alleged spy.
